result.summary: Every race in ClickDeletionRaceTest now proves its interleaving: the first transaction is released only after H2 shows the second operation's session BLOCKED by it on a row-lock query for the same link; otherwise the test fails within a bound and the first transaction rolls back. Fixed sleeps removed; outcome assertions kept.

decisions.choice: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SESSIONS: SESSION_STATE BLOCKED, BLOCKER_ID equal to the first transaction's SESSION_ID(), and a 'from links ... for update' statement whose bound parameter is the link's code or id
decisions.rationale: H2 2.3 reports the blocking session and the bound parameter, so the wait is tied to the holder and to the exact row (TC-FR2-01); a start signal or an unfinished future is not used as proof

decisions.choice: Early completion and an unobserved wait fail with a diagnostic (target, holder session, last observed blocked sessions); the first transaction is marked rollback-only unless the wait was verified, and is always released
decisions.rationale: FR3 and TC-FR3-01..03; the diagnostic found my own first matcher bug (H2 shows BIGINT parameters as CAST(n AS BIGINT))

decisions.choice: All 11 outcome assertions and all 6 test methods kept; the 6 'holds lock' latch assertions are replaced by the holder's stricter bounded lock check
decisions.rationale: FR4 and TC-FR4-01, checked mechanically against the old file

decisions.choice: 9/9 race tests pass on 3 consecutive runs (~4.4 s), full suite 158 pass; mutation checks: releasing without proof fails 3 tests, accepting any blocked session fails 1, committing an unproven interleaving fails 2
decisions.rationale: A guard that cannot fail proves nothing
